name: ew-nomoreleaks-edgekv
description: EdgeWorker that checks username/password hashes against a leaked-credential list in EdgeKV

config.description: EdgeWorker that checks username/password hashes against a leaked-credential list in EdgeKV. EdgeWorker logs can be forwarded to Akamai DataStream when configured.

scripts.build-ts: tsc && npm run build-namespace && npm run package:vendor && npm run build-bundle-json
scripts.build-namespace: bash -c ': "${EDGEKV_NAMESPACE:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"; perl -0pi -e "s/__EDGEKV_NAMESPACE__/$EDGEKV_NAMESPACE/g" built/constants.js'
scripts.package:vendor: test -f vendor/edgekv_tokens.js || (echo 'ERROR: vendor/edgekv_tokens.js is missing - see vendor/edgekv_tokens.js.template or run npm run generate-edgekv-token' && exit 1) && cp vendor/edgekv.js vendor/edgekv_tokens.js built/
scripts.build-bundle-json: cd built && node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const bundle={"edgeworker-version":process.env.npm_package_version,description:process.env.npm_package_config_description}; if (process.env.EDGEWORKER_DS2_ID) bundle.config={logging:{level:process.env.EDGEWORKER_LOG_LEVEL||"info",schema:"v1",ds2id:Number(process.env.EDGEWORKER_DS2_ID),"log-uncaught-exceptions":true}}; fs.writeFileSync("bundle.json",JSON.stringify(bundle)+"\n");'
scripts.build-ew-tgz: mkdir -p dist && cd built && tar czvf "../dist/ew_${EWID:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}_$npm_package_version.tgz" *
scripts.package: npm run build-ts && npm run build-ew-tgz
scripts.upload-edgeworker: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" upload "${EWID:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}" --bundle dist/ew_"$EWID"_$npm_package_version.tgz'
scripts.activate-edgeworker: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" activate "${EWID:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}" staging $npm_package_version'
scripts.activate-edgeworker-prod: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" activate "${EWID:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}" production $npm_package_version'
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run lint && npm run package && npm run upload-edgeworker && npm run activate-edgeworker
scripts.status: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" status "${EWID:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}" --versionId $npm_package_version'
scripts.generate-token: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" auth --expiry 600 "${EW_HOSTNAME:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"'
scripts.list-groups: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" lg'
scripts.create-ew-id: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" create-id "${EW_GROUP_ID:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}" --resourceTierId "$npm_package_config_tier" "$npm_package_config_ew_name"'
scripts.list-edgekv-ns: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgekv "${args[@]}" list ns staging "${EDGEKV_NAMESPACE:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"'
scripts.list-edgekv-ns-prod: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgekv "${args[@]}" list ns production "${EDGEKV_NAMESPACE:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"'
scripts.create-edgekv-ns: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgekv "${args[@]}" create ns staging "${EDGEKV_NAMESPACE:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}" --retention 0 --groupId "${EW_GROUP_ID:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"'
scripts.create-edgekv-ns-prod: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgekv "${args[@]}" create ns production "${EDGEKV_NAMESPACE:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}" --retention 0 --groupId "${EW_GROUP_ID:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"'
scripts.generate-edgekv-token: bash -c 'ns="${EDGEKV_NAMESPACE:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"; : "${EXPIRY:?not set - pass EXPIRY=yyyy-mm-dd}" "${EWID:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"; token_file=./vendor/edgekv_tokens.js; backup_file=./vendor/edgekv_tokens.js.previous; [ -f "$token_file" ] && mv "$token_file" "$backup_file"; args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); if akamai edgekv "${args[@]}" create token "${EDGEKV_TOKEN_NAME:-nml-ro-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)}" --save_path=./vendor --staging=allow --production=allow --ewids="$EWID" --namespace="$ns"+r --expiry="$EXPIRY"; then perl -0pi -e "s/\"$ns\"\s*:/\"namespace-$ns\" :/" "$token_file"; rm -f "$backup_file"; else [ -f "$backup_file" ] && mv "$backup_file" "$token_file"; exit 1; fi'

author: jgrinwis@akamai.com
